# Research Symposium Schedule Overview

One-day university research symposium for **2026-10-14** in **Singapore Time (SGT, UTC+8)**, planned for **120 attendees** across **1 Main Hall** and **3 Breakout Rooms**. The schedule below keeps keynote, panel, and closing fully conflict-free and uses buffer time where feasible.

# Symposium Program Table

| Time (SGT) | Session | Format | Room Assignment | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 08:30-09:00 | Registration | Check-in | Foyer / Main Hall Entrance | Badge pickup, welcome desk, directional signage |
| 09:00-09:15 | Opening Remarks | Plenary | Main Hall | All attendees |
| 09:15-10:00 | Keynote Address | Plenary | Main Hall | No parallel sessions |
| 10:00-10:20 | Coffee Break | Break | Foyer | Refreshments and informal mingling |
| 10:20-11:00 | Breakout Session 1A | Parallel talks | Breakout Room 1 | Research Track A |
| 10:20-11:00 | Breakout Session 1B | Parallel talks | Breakout Room 2 | Research Track B |
| 10:20-11:00 | Breakout Session 1C | Parallel talks | Breakout Room 3 | Research Track C |
| 11:00-11:10 | Transition Buffer | Buffer | All breakout areas | Room change and AV reset |
| 11:10-11:50 | Breakout Session 2A | Parallel talks | Breakout Room 1 | Research Track D |
| 11:10-11:50 | Breakout Session 2B | Parallel talks | Breakout Room 2 | Research Track E |
| 11:10-11:50 | Breakout Session 2C | Parallel talks | Breakout Room 3 | Research Track F |
| 11:50-12:00 | Transition Buffer | Buffer | All rooms | Move to lunch area |
| 12:00-13:00 | Lunch | Meal break | Dining Area / Foyer | Buffet or boxed lunch |
| 13:00-14:00 | Poster Session | Poster showcase | Main Hall | Poster boards around perimeter; all attendees circulate |
| 14:00-14:15 | Transition Buffer | Buffer | Main Hall | Reset seating for panel |
| 14:15-15:00 | Panel Discussion | Plenary | Main Hall | No parallel sessions |
| 15:00-15:20 | Coffee Break | Break | Foyer | Refreshments before workshops |
| 15:20-16:20 | Workshop Block W1 | Interactive workshop | Breakout Room 1 | Methods / tools workshop |
| 15:20-16:20 | Workshop Block W2 | Interactive workshop | Breakout Room 2 | Writing / publishing workshop |
| 15:20-16:20 | Workshop Block W3 | Interactive workshop | Breakout Room 3 | Industry / innovation workshop |
| 16:20-16:30 | Transition Buffer | Buffer | Main Hall | Return to plenary seating |
| 16:30-16:45 | Closing Remarks | Plenary | Main Hall | No parallel sessions |
| 16:45-17:30 | Networking Reception | Networking | Main Hall + Foyer | Light refreshments, speaker meet-and-greet |

# Organizer Setup Notes

- **Room flow:** Use **Main Hall** for all plenary items and poster session; reserve **Breakout Rooms 1-3** for morning parallel sessions and the afternoon workshop block.
- **Attendance planning:** With 120 attendees, assume roughly **40 per breakout room**; prepare overflow chairs and one floating staff member for room balancing.
- **Poster layout:** Place poster boards in the **Main Hall perimeter or adjacent foyer** so attendees can circulate easily without needing another room move.
- **Buffer protection:** Keep the **11:00-11:10**, **11:50-12:00**, **14:00-14:15**, and **16:20-16:30** buffers intact for AV reset, speaker changeover, and crowd movement.
- **AV staffing:** Assign one AV lead in the **Main Hall** and one roaming technician for the **3 breakout rooms** during parallel sessions.
- **Signage:** Use color-coded signs for **Breakout Rooms 1-3** and print the room map on badges or the event handout.

# Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Copy Schedule] https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/singapore/singapore
Action: [Button: Venue Time Check] https://www.timeanddate.com/time/zone/singapore

# Sources

- Time zone reference for Singapore: <https://www.timeanddate.com/time/zone/singapore>
- Singapore local time overview: <https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/singapore/singapore>
